text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—To think that even I could be so deeply 
shaken...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I only meant to kill some time, 
but... You truly are... a sinful one...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A tragic fate, an inevitable clash between 
justice and justice... I underestimated it 
as mere kids' stuff. I ought to say thanks 
to Biko for broadening my horizons.
